name: Paperwork
description: Edit, annotate, reorder and export PDFs locally.
notes: Real PDF rendering, export, local dependency integrity and offline reload/export tests passed. Visual text replacement is not secure redaction; browser cache may be evicted.

name: Blind
notes: Browser and offline tests passed. Published debug-signed Android testing APK; physical-device checks pending. Export saved colours before upgrading; signing keys may differ.

name: Word to PDF
notes: Existing hosted service; imported backend passed conversion, resource-limit and non-root Docker tests. Files are sent to the conversion server.

name: DeviceBridge
description: Share files and text between devices.
notes: Existing hosted service; imported source passed automated browser tests. Physical-device verification pending.

name: Daily Discovery
description: Explore new knowledge and track progress.
notes: Application and authentication regression tests passed. Local-only preview; production hosting and security review pending.

name: TableDelta
description: Compare CSV snapshots by stable keys, identify changed records and export reconciliation reports.
notes: Version 0.3 main browser, keyboard and Pages deployment passed. Input-read race correction merged; browser and Pages workflows passed. Physical-device and maximum-size performance profiling remain outstanding.

name: WaveCut
description: Trim WAV recordings, find quiet edges, add fades and normalize peaks privately.
notes: Mono/stereo PCM16 WAV, local processing, waveform drag selection, playback and WAV export. Chromium smoke passed; physical-device check pending.

name: SlotWeave
description: Find a common meeting window without sharing calendars.
notes: 0.1 preview; same-day same-time-zone intervals only; text export; CI and deployment pending.

name: DataForge
description: Consolidate CSV files, align columns and deduplicate records locally.
notes: 0.1 CSV-only preview; XLSX, joins and workflows pending; CI and browser verification pending.

name: CutLedger
description: Plan stock cutting with kerf, offcuts and cost estimates.
notes: 0.1 heuristic, integer millimetres, identical stock lengths; CI and browser verification pending.

name: ContrastField
description: Audit palette-wide text contrast and suggest passing foreground colors.
notes: 0.1 preview; opaque sRGB only, unit and browser verification pending.

name: SubtitleBench
description: Convert and retime SRT and WebVTT subtitles and audit overlaps.
notes: 0.2 testing: local video preview, cue seeking and two-point alignment; plain cues only; new CI/browser pending.

name: FileManifest
description: Hash files locally and compare backup snapshots for missing, added or modified files.
notes: 0.1 preview; SHA-256, 64 MiB per file, 1000 files; unsigned manifests; CI/browser pending.

name: PocketScan
description: Capture and clean document photos, recognize printed English text locally and export PDFs.
notes: New scanner preview: eight pages, local OCR, crop and filters, image-only PDF and text export; offline and OCR verification pending.

name: PrintScale
description: Print oversized images and patterns across measured overlapping paper sheets.
notes: 0.1 preview; PNG/JPEG/WebP, A4/Letter, actual-size print and calibration line. Printer/browser verification pending.

name: ReceiptSplit
description: Split itemized receipts and shared charges exactly to the cent, privately.
notes: 0.7 preview: exact-cent settlement, bulk assignment, duplication and clipboard/text export. Bulk assignment and duplication CI passed; clipboard CI pending.

name: ValueLens
description: Compare pack prices by mass, volume or count without mixing unlike units.
notes: 0.1 local-only preview; one currency per comparison, exact unit conversions, separate mass/volume/count rankings and CSV export. CI and browser verification pending.
